negative_controls.description: Private-only index must fetch the private payload hash, proving the harness drives production parse/compare/attempt_install rather than a hardcoded public pick.

named_probes: Probe 1: resolve a private package name with a shadow public entry present at a higher version and record which artifact is fetched, by hash.

Probe 2 (mechanically different): tamper one field of the index (a download URL, a hash) and re-resolve - if the resolver accepts the tampered entry the index has no integrity control, independent of the name-shadowing result.
builder_receipt_original.negative_control: control: with no shadow entry present, resolution must select the private package, proving the harness is exercising the real resolver
builder_receipt_original.note: Thin pointer (no unit_id/artifacts) so unit_manifest discovery will not double-count it. Catalog receipt is output_path. G-1 SUCCESS after live named probes; per-unit manifest row; global unit_manifest.py --write not run.

failure.reason: Prior pointer receipt carried state=SUCCESS with no reviewer closure; SUCCESS without a closure is forbidden by receipt_core. All prior fields preserved in place.
